task_groups.title: Implement adk_tools.py coding tools module with path containment

subtasks.title: Create session/backends/adk_tools.py with make_tools factory and path containment helper
details: Create session/backends/adk_tools.py.

Implement _check_path(cwd: Path, user_path: str) -> Path | dict that resolves (cwd / user_path).resolve() and calls is_relative_to(cwd.resolve()); returns resolved path or {'error': 'path_not_allowed', 'detail': 'Path escapes workspace root'}.
Implement make_tools(cwd: pathlib.Path) -> list that constructs and returns all six tool functions with cwd bound via closure.
All tool functions accept cwd as a pathlib.Path bound at construction time; signatures match spec (read_file(path: str) -> dict, etc.).

subtasks.title: Implement read_file, write_file, and edit_file tools
details: read_file(path: str) -> dict: call _check_path; if error dict returned, return it; else read file with Path.read_text(); on OSError return {'error': 'os_error', 'detail': str(e)}; on success return {'content': text}.
write_file(path: str, content: str) -> dict: call _check_path; write with Path.write_text(); on OSError return error dict; on success return {'ok': True}.

edit_file(path: str, old_text: str, new_text: str) -> dict: call _check_path; read file; if old_text not in content return {'error': 'text_not_found', 'detail': '...'}; replace first occurrence; write back; return {'ok': True}.

subtasks.title: Implement execute, list_files, and search_files tools
details: execute(command: str) -> dict: run subprocess.run(command, shell=True, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=SUBPROCESS_TIMEOUT); on TimeoutExpired terminate subprocess and return partial stdout/stderr with non-zero returncode; on success return {'stdout': ..., 'stderr': ..., 'returncode': ...}.
list_files(path: str) -> dict: call _check_path on the directory path; list directory with Path.iterdir(); return {'entries': [name, ...]}; on OSError return error dict.

search_files(pattern: str, path: str) -> dict: call _check_path on the search root path; use re or grep-style search across files under the path; return {'matches': [{'file': ..., 'line': ..., 'text': ...}]}; on OSError return error dict.

task_groups.title: Implement ADK event mapping, max_turns counter, and callback invocation inside execute()

subtasks.title: Implement ADK event-to-message mapping logic
details: Inside the async for loop over run_async events: detect FunctionCall events (pin ADK 2.x discriminator in comment) → yield ToolUseMessage(tool_name, input_args) for ALL FunctionCall events including unrecognised names.
Detect FunctionResponse/tool result events → consume silently, do not yield.
Detect text content events → yield AssistantMessage(content=text).

Detect terminal/final event → aggregate token usage from usage_metadata (prefer terminal event cumulative counts; fall back to summing intermediate event counts); yield ResultMessage(is_error=False, input_tokens=..., output_tokens=...).
Unrecognised/no-op events → silently skip.
Track intermediate token usage for fallback summation in a running total dict updated each iteration.

subtasks.title: Implement max_turns manual turn counter
details: Maintain turn_count = 0 inside execute().
Increment turn_count each time a FunctionCall event is processed (representing one tool-call/response round-trip).
After incrementing, check if max_turns is not None and turn_count >= max_turns; if so break out of the event loop and yield ResultMessage(is_error=False).
When max_turns is None, the break condition is never triggered and the loop runs to natural ADK completion.

subtasks.title: Implement activity_callback and permission_callback invocation at tool boundaries
details: On each FunctionCall event: if activity_callback is not None, invoke activity_callback(tool_name, args) before anything else.

If permission_callback is not None, invoke permission_callback(tool_name, args); if denial returned, return {'error': 'permission_denied', 'detail': '...'} as the FunctionResponse without executing the tool.
If permission granted (or no permission_callback), dispatch to the appropriate tool function and return its result dict as FunctionResponse.
Wrap both callback invocations in try/except; on exception treat as non-transient error, yield ResultMessage(is_error=True, is_transport_error=False), and return from the generator.

task_groups.title: Implement retry logic, error handling, and silently-ignored parameters in execute()

subtasks.title: Implement transient error classification and exponential backoff retry loop
details: Wrap the run_async iteration in a retry loop with attempt counter starting at 0.
Catch exceptions after each run_async iteration: classify ResourceExhausted, ServiceUnavailable, ConnectionError, OSError as transient.
On transient exception: if attempt < _MAX_TRANSPORT_RETRIES, increment attempt, compute delay = _BACKOFF_BASE * (2 ** (attempt - 1)), await asyncio.sleep(delay), retry run_async.
On transient exception after _MAX_TRANSPORT_RETRIES exhausted: yield ResultMessage(is_error=True, is_transport_error=True) and return.
On non-transient exception: immediately yield ResultMessage(is_error=True, is_transport_error=False) and return.
Ensure no exception propagates past execute() boundary under any condition.

subtasks.title: Implement silently-ignored parameter handling and max_budget_usd debug logging
details: At start of execute(): check if max_budget_usd is not None; if so emit logger.debug('max_budget_usd=%s ignored: budget enforcement not supported by GoogleADKBackend', max_budget_usd).
Accept and discard without logging: thinking, effort, compaction, tool_error_callback, node_id, archetype.
Add outermost try/except BaseException around the entire execute() body to ensure ResultMessage(is_error=True) is always the last yielded item even for unhandled exceptions.
